posts.content_md:
So we don't have to email so many articles between us I have made a place for articles for their authors. I don't have a fancy index page yet but I'll work on one.

[http://www.holographyforum.org/files/](http://www.holographyforum.org/files/)

If you would like me to include one just drop it into an email to me if you send a description of the file I wile include it on the index page.

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md: Good idea! I've had a lot of requests for Ken Dunkley's paper on table stability. Would you like me to scan them and email you?

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: As long as we have the authors permissions, I will post anything. If you have a lot of papers please put them on a CD. I would like to have a copy of your silver halide article as well. I only have a paper copy.
